name: Jokyoushi Rinkan no Kyoushitsu
original_name: 女教師　輪姦の教室
source: Ishida Shuichi comes back to his hometown deep in the mountains as he transfers to Hiyama private school, a prestigious high school that only those of the elite with very high recommendations can enter. He came at the time of an annual school event that it's held for an entire week, the Great student council, in which the students decide the future of the school management. What are his real reasons to come back to Hiyama?
translation: 石田修一转学到桧山私立学校，回到深山中的故乡。这是一所名门高中，只有获得极高推荐的精英才能入学。他回来的时机正值为期一周的年度校园活动「大学生会」，学生将在其中决定学校经营的未来。修一回到桧山的真正理由是什么？
